richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the potential exists that the single locking driver's seat height adjustment mechanism might drop without prior warning.
richiami.rimedio: To address the issue all subject seats will have their height adjustment units replaced.
richiami.titolo: DRIVER'S SEAT MAY DROP WITHOUT WARNING

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that the seatbelt stalk mountings may fail inder extreme load conditions.
richiami.modello: PASSENGER SEAT BELT ATTACHMENT , PASSENGER SEAT BELT ATTACHMENT
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the seatbelt stalk attachment bracket bolted directly to the seat frame.
